# Necromancy Ritual Calculator

> A free web calculator for Necromancy rituals in RuneScape 3 (RS3). Players choose a ritual, its focus item,
> a ritual site, alteration glyphs and ritual gear, and see what the rituals use and make, what they cost, how
> long they take, the XP they give and their soul attraction. An Ironman mode adds the rituals that make the
> necroplasm for ink. Players can also keep a list of the ritual items they own, read from a screenshot of
> their bank, with live Grand Exchange prices.

This file is for AI assistants answering players' questions about using the site: the full guide. A
summary is at [llms.txt](https://rituals.duke605.ca/llms.txt). Game data (rituals, glyphs, inks, items,
gear, examine text) comes from the RuneScape Wiki. Prices come from the RuneScape Wiki's real-time prices.

## Pages

- [Rituals](https://rituals.duke605.ca/): the calculator. The site's home page.
- [Inventory](https://rituals.duke605.ca/inventory): the ritual items the player owns, with prices.
- [Help](https://rituals.duke605.ca/help): the site's own guide:
  [Getting started](https://rituals.duke605.ca/help/getting-started),
  [Glyphs and gear](https://rituals.duke605.ca/help/glyphs-and-gear),
  [Results](https://rituals.duke605.ca/help/results),
  [Ironman mode](https://rituals.duke605.ca/help/ironman-mode) and
  [Inventory and prices](https://rituals.duke605.ca/help/inventory-and-prices).

## Calculating a ritual

The Rituals page shows a ritual site from above: square slates for glyphs, five-sided slates for light
sources, and a round plinth (the focus) in the middle. The ritual's glyphs and its focus item are placed on
it automatically.

1. Choose the site from the **Site** dropdown above it: **The Underworld** or **Ungael**. Both have 11 glyph
   spots and 10 light sources.
2. Choose the ritual: click the item on the plinth, or the **Select focus** button beside the **Site**
   dropdown. In the **Choose ritual** dialog, pick the ritual from **Ritual** (each shows its Necromancy
   level) and the item to use from **Focus item** (some rituals accept several, e.g. different bones), then
   press **Choose**.
3. Add alteration glyphs in the **Alteration glyphs** panel, left of the site (under it on phones and
   tablets): use − and + beside Multiply, Speed, Protection or Attraction, tiers I to III. The × before a
   count sets it back to 0. They go in the glyph spots the ritual's own glyphs leave free; the panel says how
   many are left. Alteration glyphs are kept for each ritual separately.
4. Choose ritual gear in the **Equipment** panel, under **Results**: click a slot (head, back, neck, pocket,
   torso, legs, hands, feet or ring), pick an item and press **Choose**. **Unequip** takes it off. The
   ritualist's outfit slots also offer **Entire Ritualist's Outfit**, with the plain or the modified mask,
   to wear all five pieces at once.
5. Read the **Results** panel, right of the site. Its lists fold away by their titles.
   - **Rituals**: how many rituals the results are for. It starts at the golden ratio, shown under the
     field: the fewest rituals that wear every glyph out at once, so no glyph is redrawn early. The number
     shimmers gold on any multiple of it; the < and > arrows jump to the previous or next multiple. Empty the
     field to go back to the golden ratio.
   - The settings: **Take from inventory**, **Ironman Mode** and **No waste** (see below).
   - **Rituals to perform**: each ritual and how many times. Hover one for its time each and in total.
   - **Input**: the focus items, and the ink (and ectoplasm, for alteration glyphs) to draw the glyphs as
     often as they wear out. In Ironman mode, what the ink is made from instead.
   - **Output**: everything the rituals make (products, ectoplasm and, for communion rituals, souls), with
     Multiply glyphs and gear counted. Hover an item in Input or Output for its prices; click it to set its
     price.
   - **Totals**: the input's cost and the output's value at the item prices, the profit or loss, the number
     of rituals, the disturbance chances, the duration and the XP (without disturbances).
   - **Soul attraction**: five faces, one lit per level reached (Low, Medium, High, Extreme, Dangerous).
   - **Multiplier**: how much each output is multiplied, and for necroplasm with the Underworld Grimoire.

Each panel has a red reset button in its title bar, beside the arrow, that clears only that panel. **Reset all**, beside
the **Site** dropdown, clears the ritual, site, glyphs, gear and count, but keeps settings, inventory and
prices. Everything chosen is saved and comes back on the next visit.

Hovering any glyph, the focus item or worn gear shows its tooltip: what it is, its stats or effects, and its
examine text.

## Settings

- **Take from inventory** (off to begin with): items in the inventory are taken off the inputs first.
- **Ironman Mode**: ink is made, not bought, and the rituals that make its necroplasm are added (below).
- **No waste**: rounds the added rituals up to a multiple of their golden ratio. Only in Ironman mode.
- **On added rituals** (in **Alteration glyphs**, on to begin with): puts the ritual's alteration glyphs on
  the added rituals too, as many as fit. Only in Ironman mode.
- **Cape on added rituals** (in **Alteration glyphs**): the Necromancy cape glyph for the added rituals:
  **Same as worn**, **None**, or any alteration glyph. Only in Ironman mode, with a Necromancy cape worn.

Disabled settings show what they need on hover.

## Ironman mode and added rituals

- Regular, greater and powerful ghostly ink are made from 20 necroplasm of their tier, 1 ashes and 1 vial
  of water each. Basic ghostly ink can't be made (it's sold at Lupe's shop in the City of Um), and weak
  necroplasm isn't made by any ritual, so both stay inputs.
- The Lesser, Greater and Powerful necroplasm rituals are added as needed ("added rituals"). Each is done
  as few times as makes enough necroplasm for the ink, the added rituals' own ink and focus items included.
  Since more of one can mean more ink for another, the counts are worked out again until none changes.
- Added rituals are done in the Underworld, whatever site is chosen, with the same gear. Necroplasm they
  make for the ink is taken off the inputs; any left over is listed in Output.
- If putting the alteration glyphs on the added rituals never settles (they'd cost more necroplasm than
  they make), they're left off and Results says "Not self-sustaining".

## How the numbers are worked out

- **Duration**: a ritual's length is in ritual ticks of 1.2 seconds (two game ticks). Speed glyphs shorten
  it by 5%, 10% or 15% (tiers I to III). They add up, to at most 50% shorter, and the result rounds up to a
  whole ritual tick.
- **Output**: Multiply glyphs add 20%, 40% or 60% each to every output. Each amount is multiplied and rounded
  down for each ritual, so 1 item at +90% is still 1, and at +100% is 2.
- **Input**: each glyph lasts its durability in rituals (a fifth longer at Ungael, rounded down) and is
  redrawn when it wears out, a whole draw's ink at a time.
- **XP**: the ritual's own, a fifth less at Ungael, plus the ritualist's outfit.
- **Soul attraction**: every ritual starts at 100%. Each alteration glyph adds its own amount. Levels: Low up
  to 100%, Medium to 200%, High to 300%, Extreme to 500%, Dangerous over 500%.
- **Disturbance chances**: each ritual's number of chances, times how many. Which disturbances appear is
  random, so only the chances are counted.
- **Gear** that changes the results:
  - Ritualist's outfit: +1% XP a piece, and 1% more for all five (6%). The modified mask counts as the mask.
  - Necromancy cape or Necromancy master cape: one alteration glyph, chosen in the **Back** slot's dialog
    (each shows its level), works as if drawn: no spot, ink or ectoplasm.
  - Alteration necklace: alteration glyphs' effects are 20% stronger, the cape's too (e.g. Multiply I
    gives 24%).
  - Underworld Grimoire 2, 3 or 4: +5%, 10% or 15% necroplasm, on top of Multiply (not ectoplasm).
  - Ring of Kayazu: +80% soul attraction.
- Gear whose effects are shown in its tooltip but not counted: the modified ritualist's mask's 5% chance to
  keep the focus, the pumpkin masks (light sources don't wear out), the Underworld Grimoire's disturbance XP
  and the Ring of Kayazu's chance to double disturbance rewards.

## Prices

- Prices are the Grand Exchange's, fetched when the site opens (at most once an hour) and with the refresh
  button on the Inventory page.
- Basic ghostly ink and weak necroplasm can't be traded; they start at 3 coins each, their shop price. Other
  untradeable items count as 0 until priced.
- To set any item's price, owned or not: click it in **Input** or **Output** on the Rituals page (or in the
  inventory), type the price and press **Save**. The padlock keeps price updates from replacing it.

## Inventory

- **Import from bank**: paste a screenshot of the RS3 bank (hover the box and press Ctrl+V, or ⌘V on a Mac),
  drop it on the box, choose the file, or press **Paste from clipboard**. Every ritual item found is boxed:
  green when it's sure, yellow when it's unsure (several items look alike, or the amount is shortened, e.g.
  "12K") and red when it doesn't know the item. Click a box to correct its item or amount. Then choose
  **Sync** (set the inventory's amounts to the screenshot's) or **Add** (add them to what's there) and press
  the button to import. **Cancel** discards the screenshot.
- **Your items**: everything owned, by name, 200 to a page. Type in the search box to find an item (it
  tolerates typos). The + button adds an item by hand. The refresh button fetches live Grand Exchange prices
  for everything.
- Hovering an item shows its amount, GE price and high alch value. Clicking it opens **Edit item**: change
  the amount, type a price (e.g. a cheaper source than the GE), lock the price with the padlock so price
  updates leave it alone, fetch the live GE price for just that item, or **Delete** it.
- An item's slot flashes green when its amount or price goes up and red when it goes down.

## Limits

- Everything is saved in the player's browser only (it's not an account): it stays on that device and
  browser, and clearing site data erases it.
- Light sources aren't counted as inputs, and the focus-saving chance isn't taken off the focus items.
- The calculator doesn't show how many rituals the owned items cover.
- Bank screenshots must show the items' icons clearly; very small or scaled screenshots may not be read.
